versions.changelog:
- This version simplifies the skill to focus solely on bootstrapping: connecting to Alibaba Cloud Agent Data Gateway (Dgate) via the managed MCP service or installing the Dgate CLI and bundled skills.
- All business-operation details, complex workflows, and most reference files have been removed; the skill is now strictly for initial configuration and verification of access.
- Provides clear, step-by-step guidance for both MCP/AccessToken setup and CLI installation, without duplicating operational usage or requesting sensitive information in insecure ways.
- Verifies successful setup by checking connection/status for MCP, or CLI/skill installation and identity for the CLI path, and reports only when these checks pass.
- The skill is now concise, secure, and focused on getting the Agent connected to Dgate or installing the CLI—leaving all further actions to downstream tools or skills.

Initial release: Alibaba Cloud Agent Data Gateway (Dgate) Skill – read-only access layer for enterprise data governance.

- Provides guided installation, onboarding, and configuration of the Dgate CLI and Agent identity.
- Supports discovery and inspection of enterprise data resources (catalogs, databases, tables, columns, indexes) and DataWiki semantics.
- Allows policy-governed, read-only queries via MCP or CLI, with strict runtime selection and explicit steps for onboarding.
- Clearly reports results, identity, permissions, and constraints; all operations enforced read-only with detailed policy rationale.
- Designed with secure handling of credentials; never exposes sensitive tokens or allows data mutations.
- Comprehensive error handling and ambiguity management per documented workflows.
